contract: DELETE /api/items/:id/cover on an item with a stored coverPath answers 200, sets media.coverPath to null, purges the item's resized cover cache, moves updatedAt and emits item_updated; the cover file itself is left on disk (upstream removes no file) and later raw and resized reads answer 404. DELETE cover on an item whose coverPath is already null answers 200 without moving updatedAt or emitting item_updated. DELETE cover answers 401 without a token, 404 for an unknown item (the item lookup precedes the permission check), 403 without access to the item's library and 403 without the delete permission, changing nothing and emitting no event.
exceptions: force is not applicable: DELETE has no force or override mode.
The DELETE route does not remove the cover file upstream (it only clears the pointer); the scenario asserts the file stays, so a target that deletes it fails.
